headline: CFTC approves a blockchain-based derivatives exchange

scenes.vo: American regulators just approved a derivatives exchange and clearinghouse that settle trades on a blockchain. Here's what changed.

On Monday, the CFTC approved an exchange license and a clearinghouse registration for a firm using blockchain settlement. Backpack says that firm is its own. T Zero also won an exchange approval last week.
Here's why traders are watching it. Backpack calls it the first blockchain-based derivatives exchange in America, meaning regulated futures could trade and settle onchain.
The catch. The CFTC statement doesn't name the firm, and an approval is not a launch. Products, timing and who can trade are still to come.
Here's what happens next. Watch for Backpack's launch date and first products, and whether more crypto firms win the same approval.
